title: salix cordata var. rigida
intro: Salix cordata var. rigida, commonly known as the stiffleaf willow, is a plant species in the willow family (Salicaceae). It is known for its slender branches and narrow leaves that grow in a stiff and upright manner. The health benefits of Salix cordata var. rigida include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, a compound with analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, and flavonoids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory actions.
